scope: Local binary proximal operations, a specified one-dimensional periodic affine projection, restricted finite-grid rates and surrogate bounds. No general full solver, continuum convergence, uniform conditioning, bit-complexity or arbitrary-offspring theorem.
interpretation_requirements: Primal feasible gap-certificate inputs have finite objective value.
The surrogate infimum comparison uses the same admissible class, diffusion constraint, growth and mass bounds, and a finite-cost competitor.
Affine projection does not preserve density positivity.
